pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   C. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Surah Naas? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah Naas.
   B. Apply the teaching of Surah Naas with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Surah Naas to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Surah Naas has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Manners of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of.
   C. Say Manners of has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Manners of to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

8. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Belief in has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

11. Which response best shows understanding of My extended family? (1 mark)
   A. Use My extended family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say My extended family has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My extended family.
   D. Apply the teaching of My extended family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   C. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Manners of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Names of Scriptures able to: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
